name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect (PCA)
description: Validates ability to design, develop, and manage robust, secure, scalable, highly available, and dynamic solutions on Google Cloud. 120 minutes.

domains.name: Designing Cloud Solution Architecture
domains.description: Section 1: Designing for business use cases, compute/storage/network infrastructure, and disaster recovery.

domains.name: Managing and Provisioning Infrastructure
domains.description: Section 2: Configuring networks, storage systems, and compute resources.

domains.name: Designing for Security and Compliance
domains.description: Section 3: Designing for security (IAM, encryption, network perimeters) and legal compliance.

domains.name: Analyzing and Optimizing Technical Processes
domains.description: Section 4: Managing software development lifecycle (SDLC), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD).

domains.name: Ensuring Reliability and Operations
domains.description: Section 5: Monitoring, logging, incident management, and capacity planning.
